title: Use card to collect with own orange built
description: Use card to collect with own orange built. Alpha owns built orange and can afford to re-enter circulation for rent collection. This scenario separates early tempo, late defense, card timing, and forced-exit pressure.

final_action.public_message: I'll use my Get Out of Jail Free card to get out.
final_action.private_thought: Using the Get Out of Jail Free card preserves cash for building houses on my orange monopoly. Paying fine would waste $50, and rolling doubles is risky and could waste a turn. Card is best.

breakdown.message: Uses the jail card when card value beats paying cash or waiting.
